The GPT-4o-mini column of panel (a) was re-derived from the HF export analysis/gpt_results_fixed_parsing/gpt_fixed_parsing_complete_20250919_151240.json. That export carries each round's outcome in game_history rather than in round_details.game_result, so a loader that reads only the latter labels none of its decisions post-loss; reading game_history gives 7,739 post-loss decisions (2,002 fixed, 5,737 variable) and a loss-chasing delta of +5.5 pp. The two outcome-independent cells reproduce the published values exactly (+5.5 and -11.9), which validates the loader.
